# Reticulum interface names as RNS 1.5.7 prints them, and as the ingestor
# posts them and the web stores them: without a peer address (SPEC RI1, RI2).
# One case per line, three tab-separated columns: case, printed name, public
# name. tests/test_reticulum_interface_names.py builds each case it knows from
# the real RNS class and checks the printed name; the other cases are hand-made.
# web/spec/interface_names_spec.rb checks the web gives the same public name.
# An RNode sub-interface prints <parent>[<sub>]: a parent name that reads as a
# class name (an identifier without "rnode") is cut like an unknown class's,
# The i2p_peer_base64_kelvin* and i2p_peer_base64_long_s* cases end with U+212A
# (Kelvin) or U+017F (long s), which no base64 destination holds: neither copy of
# the rule may fold them into ASCII.
